title: Classification of semialgebraic projective universal covers
exact_target: For a connected normal projective complex variety X, is its universal cover biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety exactly when it is $D×C^m×F$, where $m\geq 0$, D is a bounded symmetric domain, and F is simply connected normal projective? Point factors are allowed and deck transformations need not be algebraic.
